subject: Prep: technical preflight & evidence handoff (SOC 2 / DPA / pen test)
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey@bluepine.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prep: technical preflight & evidence handoff (SOC 2 / DPA / pen test)

Hi Audrey / BluePine security team,

Thanks again for moving forward with the SOC 2 / DPA review and the pen test kickoff. Before the formal walkthrough we'd like to run a short technical preflight so we can:
- Confirm evidence locations and access controls (S3 buckets, shared Drive folder)
- Walk through the network diagram and any VPN/JIT details that affect access during the pen test
- Validate attendee roles and the read-only accounts your team will use for evidence review

Proposed 45-minute slots (PT):
- Tue July 15, 10:00–10:45
- Wed July 16, 14:00–14:45
- Thu July 17, 08:30–09:15

Please pick one or propose two alternate times. Marissa will run the evidence checklist; David will join for the network/VPC questions. We’ll upload the current SOC2 questionnaire and network diagram ahead of time (see attachments).

If you prefer a short walkthrough first and a separate evidence handoff session, say the word — happy to split this into two 30-minute calls.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx (stub), network-diagram.png (stub)
From: Audrey Chen <audrey@bluepine.co>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@bluepine.co
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prep: technical preflight & evidence handoff (SOC 2 / DPA / pen test)

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear outline. All looks good on our side. A couple quick notes: 

1) The team prefers the July 16 slot but would need to do 14:30–15:15 PT instead of 14:00. Is that possible?
2) For the pen test scope, can you confirm whether internal scanning will be included, or will this be external-only? Our ops lead wants to align the required firewall rule windows.
3) Evidence access: we can share a temporary read-only service account to the Drive folder and a presigned S3 link for the buckets. We’ll need your IAM contact to exchange the account email for ACLs.

If July 16 14:30 works for you, we’ll send a calendar invite and quick attendee roster.

Best,
Audrey Chen
Head of InfoSec | BluePine, Inc.
audrey@bluepine.co

Subject: Re: Prep: technical preflight & evidence handoff (SOC 2 / DPA / pen test)

Perfect — July 16 at 14:30–15:15 PT works for us. I’ve booked the 45-minute slot on our side and we’ll wait for your calendar invite.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Pen test scope: Redwood will coordinate with your vendor; for this engagement we expect the initial phase to be external-only scans/tests. If you want internal scanning later, we can schedule a second window and list the required firewall/JIT rules.
- Evidence access: please send the Drive-sharing email address to marissa.cole@redwood.ai and the presigned S3 URL to david.kim@redwood.ai. Marissa will confirm once she has read-only access.

Agenda (45 minutes):
1) 5 min intros / goals for the preflight
2) 10 min evidence locations and sample file walk (Marissa)
3) 15 min network diagram & access considerations (David)
4) 10 min calendar & logistics: pen test windows, DPA reviewers, follow-ups

If you want to add anyone (ops lead, vendor contact), please CC them on the invite. We’ll surface the SOC2 questionnaire and the network diagram to the drive link in advance.

Thanks — see you July 16.
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
